tests.name: Controls and Indicators Risk via Usability Engineering Process
tests.requirement: RISKS associated with arrangement of controls and indicators of ME EQUIPMENT addressed through application of USABILITY ENGINEERING PROCESS in accordance with IEC 60601-1-6

tests.name: Mechanical wear / degradation parts accessibility
tests.requirement: Parts subject to mechanical wear, electrical, environmental degradation or ageing resulting in unacceptable RISK are accessible for inspection, replacement, and maintenance

tests.name: Servicing without damage to adjacent parts
tests.requirement: Inspection, servicing, replacement, and adjustment of parts can easily be done without damage to or interference with adjacent parts or wiring
tests.result: Only a qualified personnel service is available to implement.

tests.name: Mould stress relief, push, impact, drop, and rough handling tests
tests.requirement: Tests did not result in loss of BASIC SAFETY or ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE

tests.name: Push test
tests.requirement: External parts of ENCLOSURE subjected to steady force of 250 N ± 10 N for 5 s applied to a circular (30mm) plane surface, except bottom of ENCLOSURE of ME EQUIPMENT >18 kg
tests.sub_result: No damage resulting in an unacceptable RISK sustained

tests.name: Impact test
tests.requirement: Complete ENCLOSURE or its largest non-reinforced area subjected to a free falling 500 g ±25 g solid smooth steel ball, approx. 50 mm diameter from height of 1.3 m; no damage resulting in unacceptable RISK

tests.name: Drop test – HAND-HELD ME EQUIPMENT
tests.requirement: Sample of HAND-HELD ME EQUIPMENT, ACCESSORIES and HAND-HELD part with SAFE WORKING LOAD allowed to fall freely once from each of 3 different positions as in NORMAL USE from height specified in ACCOMPANYING DOCUMENTS, or from 1 m onto a 50 mm ±5 mm thick hardwood board on concrete or rigid base

tests.name: Drop test – PORTABLE ME EQUIPMENT
tests.requirement: Sample of PORTABLE ME EQUIPMENT, ACCESSORIES and PORTABLE part with SAFE WORKING LOAD lifted to height per Table 29 above a 50 ±5 mm thick hardwood board on concrete floor or rigid base, dropped 3 times from each orientation in NORMAL USE
tests.sub_result: No damage resulting in an unacceptable RISK sustained

tests.name: Rough Handling tests – MOBILE ME EQUIPMENT
tests.requirement: Each sample of MOBILE ME EQUIPMENT and MOBILE part with SAFE WORKING LOAD in most adverse condition in NORMAL USE passed Rough Handling tests
tests.result: Not mobile me equipment and mobile part

sub_tests.label: a) Ascending step shock test
sub_tests.description: Sample pushed 3 times in normal direction of travel at 0.8 m/s ±0.1 m/s against ascending hardwood step obstruction without going over

sub_tests.label: b) Descending step shock test
sub_tests.description: Sample pushed 3 times in normal direction of travel at 0.8 m/s ±0.1 m/s to fall over vertical step affixed flat on rigid base

sub_tests.label: c) Door frame shock test
sub_tests.description: Sample moved 3 times in normal direction of travel at 0.8 m/s ±0.1 m/s, or for motor driven equipment at maximum possible speed, against hardwood vertical obstacle higher than equipment contact point(s)

tests.sub_result: No damage resulting in an unacceptable RISK sustained

tests.name: Mould-stress relief test
tests.requirement: ENCLOSURE made from moulded or formed thermoplastic material examined; mould-stress relief test conducted by placing sample in circulating air oven at 10°C over max temperature measured on ENCLOSURE in 11.1.3, but no less than 70°C, for 7 hours
tests.sub_result: Examination indicated material distortion will not result in unacceptable RISK

regulations.title: Medical electrical equipment – Part 1: General requirements for basic safety and essential performance
Medical electrical equipment – Usability Engineering Process

semantic_fragments.content: Notification that changes to the IT-NETWORK could introduce new RISKS that require additional analysis. Changes to the IT-NETWORK include: changes in network configuration, connection of additional items, disconnection of items, update of equipment, upgrade of equipment.

Clause 15.2: Inspection, servicing, replacement, and adjustment of parts of ME EQUIPMENT can easily be done without damage to or interference with adjacent parts or wiring. Result: Only a qualified personnel service is available to implement.
